#Roleplay Rule 19 - Free Agents
There are multiple types of free agents on Goob. Below will be a list of these with explanations of their allowed gameplay and intention. This is not an exhaustive list but requires a level of common sense to understand the differences.
## Skeletons Skeletons are considered the truest free agents. You are allowed to do anything on a whim whether it's killing, helping, causing minor or major problems or even getting a job and becoming a normal crewmember.
Skeletons are not allowed to cause mass station sabotage such as but not limited to: Loosing tesla. Creating massive explosions.
[bold] Skeletons are an exception in the “Free agent” status. Having “Free agent” in your character’s status does not mean you are under the same rules/freedom that a skeleton is under.[/bold]
## Animals Animals are expected to behave in a way befitting of the animal. Mice are expected to look for food and survive, monkeys are expected to be funky smaller people and pets such as walter, smile ect are expected to behave well.
[bold]Excessive shittery as an animal such as a mouse can lead to punishment.[/bold]
## Abductee’s Abductee’s are crewmates with a slight kink. As an abductee you will get a roleplay objective to attempt to change your general behavior.
[bold]Abductee’s are not antagonists, while you are given more freedom to do your objective your character is still your character. Use of this status to behave in an antagonistic way may be punished harshly by admins.[/bold]
## Singuloth Knights Your final and only goal as a singuloth knight is to ensure the station is running a proper singularity and ensure there are no teslas on the station. You may use violence to accomplish your goal but should generally try diplomacy first. When picking this role you are expected to know and understand engineering and be able to replace the tesla seamlessly. Incompetence in this process can get you banned from the role.
